description:
NinjaTrader 8 is open on the Windows desktop with real daily OHLCV data for SPY (Jan 2023–Dec 2024). A swing trader needs to filter noise from the RSI indicator.

Your task:
1. Open a new Chart for 'SPY' with 'Daily' bars.
2. Add an 'RSI' indicator (Period 14) to the chart.
3. Add an 'SMA' indicator (Period 10) to the chart.
4. CRITICAL: Configure the SMA's 'Input Series' to use the 'RSI' you just added (do not apply it to the Close price). This will smooth the RSI values.
5. Ensure both the RSI and the SMA appear in the same sub-panel below the price chart.
6. Save the workspace to persist your changes.

Note: In the Indicators dialog, you may need to add the RSI first for it to be available as an Input Series for the SMA.
